task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OIDC-05 at src/design/oidc-05-bearer-token-acceptance.md. Design how API-08 Bearer authentication is extended to accept both OIDC-issued JWTs and internally-issued tokens from IDN-04 using unambiguous token-format inspection and deterministic routing to the correct verifier path. Include malformed and indeterminate token handling that returns HTTP 401 with structured error responses. Define module boundaries, decision pipeline stages, error contracts, and test seams demonstrating coexistence of both token types. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines unambiguous token-type detection for OIDC JWT vs internal token
Design maps each token type to its dedicated verification path with coexistence behavior
Design specifies malformed/indeterminate token handling with structured HTTP 401 errors
Design maps OIDC-05 acceptance criteria to concrete implementation and test points
Design identifies backend files/touchpoints for Step 02 implementation and Step 03/04 testing

result.summary: Designed OIDC-05 bearer token acceptance at src/design/oidc-05-bearer-token-acceptance.md with deterministic token-format inspection, unambiguous routing to OIDC vs IDN-04 verifier paths, and structured HTTP 401 contracts for malformed/indeterminate tokens.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) and then TEST-DESIGNER (Step 03) and TEST-RUNNER (Step 04) for OIDC-05 implementation and verification.
